title: The Star That Vanished—And Left a Ripple in Space-Time
hook: A massive star in a nearby galaxy simply disappeared without a supernova, and the gravitational wave it left behind is unlike anything we've seen.
why_this_can_go_viral: A star that just vanishes triggers immediate existential curiosity—viewers will want to know if this could happen to our Sun.

title: The Extinction Event That Was Caused by a 'Star Scream'
hook: A gamma ray burst from a dying star may have triggered a mass extinction 450 million years ago—and we're in the crosshairs again.
why_this_can_go_viral: Connecting a terrifying cosmic event to past extinction makes it feel imminent and personal.

title: The Dark Matter 'Anti-Star' That Emits No Light
hook: Astronomers found an object in deep space that emits zero light but has the gravitational pull of a star—it could be made of dark matter.
why_this_can_go_viral: The idea of an invisible star challenges everything we know about the universe and fuels dark matter conspiracy theories.

title: The Fermi Paradox Answer: They Were Here Before Us—And Left Traps
hook: What if the reason we see no aliens is that previous civilizations were destroyed by ancient booby traps left in the cosmos?
why_this_can_go_viral: A dark, counterintuitive twist on the Fermi Paradox that sparks fear and speculation about hidden dangers in space.

title: The Signal That Came From a Dead Star—And It's Repeating

why_this_can_go_viral: A repeating signal from a dead star feels eerie and raises the question: is something still alive out there?

title: The Declassified CIA File That Describes a 'Dark Matter Weapon'
hook: A recently declassified CIA document discusses a 'device' that manipulates dark matter to create gravitational anomalies—in the 1970s.
why_this_can_go_viral: The combination of government secrecy, dark matter, and weaponization hits multiple conspiracy triggers.

title: The Star That Is Eating Its Own Planets—In Real Time
hook: A white dwarf is shredding an entire planetary system and consuming the debris—we're watching a solar system die.
why_this_can_go_viral: Watching a star devour its own children is visceral, tragic, and a reminder of Earth's eventual fate.

title: The Dark Matter 'Tsunami' That Passed Through Earth Last Year
hook: Scientists detected a massive wave of dark matter washing over our planet—and it may have altered atomic clocks.
why_this_can_go_viral: An invisible wave hitting Earth without warning is deeply unsettling and feels like a cosmic horror premise.

why_this_can_go_viral: A near-disaster in space hidden by governments plays on distrust and the hidden dangers of militarized orbit.

title: The Asteroid That Will Trigger a 'Ring of Fire' When It Hits

why_this_can_go_viral: The visual of a 'Ring of Fire' encircling the Pacific is apocalyptic and highly shareable.

title: The Exoplanet That Is Sending a 'Pulsing' Signal—In Morse Code

hook: A crystal embedded in a meteorite is exhibiting properties that can only be explained by dark matter—and it's slowly expanding.

why_this_can_go_viral: The black cube is a powerful visual symbol, and the implication of a recovered alien artifact is irresistible.
